newsitem.title: POLAND: Amerbank buys into leasing company.
newsitem.headline: Amerbank buys into leasing company.

text.p: Bank Amerykanski w Polsce SA (Amerbank) took up 41.2 percent of the votes of Konsorcjum Inwestycyjnego Amerlease SA leasing firm after the latter's recent share issue, the bank's president said on Friday.
"We took the stake to have a leasing operation as a diversification and addition to our services which we operate now," Wlodzimierz Paszkowski said on Friday.
Amerbank, which had conducted talks with Amerlease on gaining a share almost from the latter's beginning a year and a half ago, took 700 registered shares.
Paszkowski said the deal made Amerbank Amerlease's largest shareholder as the remaining shares were dispersed among individual stockholders.
He said the firm was interested in taking on more financial institutions as investors to draw on larger credit lines in leasing activities vendors or financial institutions.
Amerlease, made about a 200,000-zloty net profit through August this year on a turnover of 1.2 million zlotys through August this year.
